actual: Ownership gaps were found late, script changes produced UI route hints, full PR/check JSON was easy to dump into chat, and manual CI polling produced repeated invalid command output.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: Ownership gaps were found late, script changes produced UI route hints, full PR/check JSON was easy to dump into chat, and manual CI polling produced repeated invalid command output.
expected: Small issue workflow should run early ownership/scope preflight, keep CI watch compact, avoid false UI-route hints for scripts, and reserve broad validation/full JSON for relevant failures or higher-risk scopes.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
reproduce_command: Process a workflow CLI change touching scripts and client wrappers; observe validation selection, UI intake hints, and CI watch output behavior.
title: Issue workflow validation selector and CI watch still waste time and tokens on small fixes

recommendations: Use compact success output; request full JSON only for failures or diagnostics.
Run targeted validation first, then final gates once the patch is stable.
Batch compatible workflow/CI/docs changes into one PR with per-issue evidence.
Use inferred UI route/scope to avoid broad repo scans; validate with frontend tsc and focused E2E when available.
Keep validation_center_backend only when the changed files actually affect Validation Center.
